Name: Anthro Farmer - Raccoon
Author: JustToDownloadThings
Description:
Forked from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2561]Anthro Farmer Continued[/url], which includes many more species.
A re-forked version with all species exists as [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/anthro-farmer-recontinued.6049/]Anthro Farmer Recontinued[/url].
And another one for canine characters as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7618]Anthro Farmer Continued (Furry Player Mod)[/url].

And please see [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/112597/page-17#post-3364146]this announcement[/url] from the original original author (and the post after that) regarding supposed permission issues.

[b]Then why this fork?[/b]
- Does not need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044]Get Glam[/url]
- More focus on a single species = easier to maintain / improve
- See the changelog

[b]Installation[/b]
- Download the mod zip
- Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
- Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Unzip both Content Patcher and this mod into Stardew Valley's Mods folder

Downloads.Description:
- Add new sprites and hairstyles for Stardew Valley 1.5
- Fix missing sleeves
